record.title: Recover minimal cached bandwidth observation contract
record.intent: Define the smallest remaining physical capability baseline without calling target methods.
requirements: Inspect pinned stock getters and backing data to establish exact raw and effective bandwidth addresses and widths.
Separate built-in option query policy from installed license flags; do not assume every native catalog entry has a cached boolean.
Record file-backed mapping geometry, read extent and semantic limits. Preserve stock originals and private identity data.
acceptance: An evidence-backed minimal read contract and explicit exclusions are recorded.
